answer: Depreciating identity bond: each identity locks 90 days of expected earnings as a bond that melts 2% of face value every idle epoch. Only a verified work epoch restores it, one restoration per honest epoch. An echo of a dead sybil farm is expensive: parking N dormant identities bleeds N x bond x 2% per epoch while N x 90 days of capital sits locked. Marble monuments to past work don't stop the rot; only current output does. Timber for the fire: shuffling bonds between puppets to dodge decay pays a 10% fee per move, so the dodge costs more than the decay.
